steps.does: Load the call and the brain view of its area.
Replay the lines through the listener, which finds gaps, contradictions and unasked kickoff items.
The model writes a short summary and next steps from the call and the suggestions.
A one-shot run has no checks beyond reading the summary; the listener rules are plain code.
No action is taken. The summary is the result.
The live session stores the call as a source for the brain.
